research_question: Can drought-resistant maize varieties maintain commercially viable grain yields under managed water-deficit conditions in semi-arid eastern Kenya?

findings.statement: Variety V2 achieved the highest average grain yield at 3.1 t/ha under drought stress, significantly outperforming V1.

findings.statement: V3 yielded 2.8 t/ha under drought stress and was not significantly different from V2, suggesting similar drought tolerance.
